notes.note: 204-209 and 212-217: no speaker recovered; party-leader variants (six). Same line for every variant.
210-211, 220-222, 227-228, 278-283: Weather Dopant (polite, mocking desu/masu speech), inferred from content (Invisible Memory planted in Methuss).
218 and 235: no speaker; inferred Negataros (rough speech, 'us', same laugh as his earlier lines). 'our trap' restores the dropped subject.
219, 225, 229, 231, 233, 236, 245, 258: no speaker; inferred Momotaros/Den-O Sword Form from his rough speech, Henshin and his signature attack. 'Henshin!!' kept as the recognisable Den-O cry.
Stumbling cry with no speaker; likely one of the Imagin being knocked about. Rendered as a sound only.
Momotaros' named attack rendered "My Special Attack, Part 2" (Ore no Hissatsu Waza Part 2), not in glossary.
No speaker recovered; 'fall back' order kept neutral.
239 lacks 'first' (no 'mazu wa') unlike 240-244; kept that difference.
Denden Sensor: W's Memory Gadget, spelled as on Kamen Rider Wiki; not in glossary. 'him' = Weather Dopant (glossary g=m).
260 and 264 are the polite variants (likely OOO/Mebius), rendered slightly more formally.
Source glosses the loanword 'lost' with the native word for it in parentheses; collapsed into one quoted "lost" since the gloss is redundant in English.
'ano kata' (an honoured superior, unnamed) rendered gender-neutral as 'the one I serve'.
285-290: names kept as the source writes them, glossary spellings (W (Shotaro), Den-O Sword Form).
Thought line; parentheses kept as in source.

report: All 80 rows translated. Speakers inferred for most of event 0146 (Weather Dopant, Negataros, Momotaros) from content. Terms not in glossary: Denden Sensor, "My Special Attack, Part 2", Spare Rider Pass, Henshin.
